headline: Your sizing after losses is costing you.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The cost of this behaviour is ₹1,05,732. It occurred in 96 after‑loss trades where the median entry size was ₹12,562 compared with your usual median of ₹6,578, giving a size ratio of 1.91x. Those after‑loss trades produced a loss of a loss of ₹1,95,375 and a win rate of 28%, versus a 39% win rate on other trades.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry stays at your usual size — about ₹6,600. If you want to size up, it has to be a separate decision made before the session, not after a loss.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is worth watching as it may be influencing your results.

closing: Consider applying the rule about keeping your entry size steady after a loss for the next review period.
